paragraphs: Shimon Sikhni—he is buried there, according to גא״י [provisionally Gelilot Eretz Yisrael]—a man of Utzah, said to Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai, “I am greater than you,” for he dug cisterns, and so forth. The midrash reads “a man of counsel” and “I am as great as you.”. He applied to him, “Than fools giving a sacrifice”: Midrash Kohelet, at “Guard your foot.”
